stem.text: Three identical plant cells were put into one of three different concentrations of sugar solution, 10%, 5% and 2.5%.
The cells were left for 50 minutes and then observed using a light microscope.

stem.alt: Outline drawing of a plant cell with a large central vacuole, labelled cell X above.
stem.label: cell X

stem.alt: Outline drawing of a plant cell with the protoplast pulled away from the cell wall, labelled cell Y above.
stem.label: cell Y

stem.alt: Outline drawing of a plant cell with the protoplast pulled away from the cell wall in several places, labelled cell Z above.
stem.label: cell Z

A.text: Cell X has the same water potential as the sugar solution it was put into.

B.text: Cell Y is turgid and cell Z is plasmolysed.

C.text: Cell Y was put into the 2.5% sugar solution.

D.text: Cell Z had a more negative water potential than the sugar solution it was put into.
